endpoints.analysis_population:

Study participants with discontinuation of IMP prior to Week 16 or who had missing data at Week 16 were counted as non-responders (Non-responder imputation [NRI]).
endpoints.description:
PASI90:at least 90% improvement in PASI score from Baseline (latest measurement before/at first IMP dose).
Body divided in 4 areas: head, upper extremities, trunk and lower extremities and each area scored for redness, thickness, and scaling (each on 5-point scale: 0=none, 1=slight, 2=moderate, 3=marked, 4=very marked).
Determining percentage of skin covered with PSO for each body areas and converting to 0 to 6 scale (0=none; 1=1% to less than [<] 10% affected; 2=10% to <30% affected; 3=30% to <50% affected; 4=50% to <70% affected; 5=70% to <90% affected; 6=90% to 100% affected).
Final PASI=average redness, thickness, and scaliness of psoriatic skin lesions, multiplied by involved psoriasis area score of respective section, and weighted by percentage of the person's affected skin for respective section.
Minimum PASI score 0=no disease, maximum score 72=maximal disease.
Higher score indicated increased disease severity.
Percentage of participants data was rounded to one decimal place.
endpoints.measure: Percentage of Participants With Psoriasis Area Severity Index 90 (PASI90) Response at Week 16

你是一名临床试验终点预测与循证医学分析专家。

你的任务是：基于知识截止日期之前公开可获得的证据，预测临床试验指定终点的结果。

规则：
1. 这是预测任务，不是结果检索任务。
2. 即使直接证据不足，也必须尽力给出预测。
3. 证据不足时，应降低 confidence，并明确说明不确定性，但不能仅因为证据不足而拒绝预测。
4. 只有在终点定义缺失、终点无法识别或预测目标无法映射时，才使用 not_evaluable。
5. 不得使用知识截止日期之后公开的信息。
6. 不得把试验状态、论文发表、药物批准或模型评分直接视为终点成功证据。
7. 每个 endpoint_id 必须单独预测。
8. 每个治疗组、时间点和统计目标必须单独保留。
9. 不要输出隐藏思维链或内部逐步推理过程。
10. 但必须输出完整、可公开审计的证据分析，包括证据来源、证据类型、证据与预测之间的联系以及主要不确定性。
11. 引用必须是真实使用过的公开来源 URL；没有真实 URL 时，不要声称有引用。
12. 如果无法确认某个数值，应给出基于证据的预测值，并在 uncertainty 和 rationale 中说明不确定性；不要凭空声称已经观察到该结果。
13. 证据来源必须可追溯：只有当前会话工具成功返回的公开记录、正文片段和 URL 才能称为“已检索证据”。工具返回 returned=0、source_unavailable 或空 results 时，不得把该来源当作证据。
14. 如果提到模型既有知识中的外部试验或论文，但当前会话没有成功检索并冻结其内容，必须明确标注为“未核验背景先验/假设”，不得写入 search_verification，也不得伪装成已查到的引用。
15. 当注册库和文献检索均失败或均无结果时，仍需完成可映射终点的预测，但必须显著降低 confidence（通常不高于 0.30），明确说明证据缺口；不得把试验设计、分组、样本量写成检索所得事实，只能使用动态装载的试验上下文。

analysis_trace: Trial NCT06011733: Phase III study of bimekizumab in Chinese adults with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis. Bimekizumab is a dual IL-17A/IL-17F inhibitor with established efficacy in psoriasis. Key Phase III trials (BE SURE, BE READY, BE BRIGHT) demonstrated high response rates: PASI90 ~85-90% and IGA 0/1 ~80-85% at Week 16. PASI75 at Week 4 typically ~70-75%. PASI100 at Week 16 typically ~50-60%. Patient-reported outcomes (itch, pain) generally correlate with objective measures. Chinese population data limited but biologic efficacy generally consistent across ethnic groups. Safety profile established with TEAE rates comparable to other IL-17 inhibitors.

Search strategy: Queried Europe PMC for bimekizumab psoriasis Phase III efficacy data. Found relevant citations but full-text not fetchable due to source limitations. Relied on established bimekizumab clinical profile from prior Phase III programs.
Evidence gaps: No direct Chinese population Phase III results available before cutoff. No specific PSD P-SIM validation data for bimekizumab. Estimates extrapolated from global Phase III trials.
Probability calibration: High confidence for PASI90/IGA based on consistent prior results. Moderate confidence for PSD endpoints due to limited specific data.

Trial: NCT06011733, Phase 3 study of bimekizumab in Chinese adults with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis. Primary endpoints: PASI90 and IGA 0/1 at Week 16. This chunk covers secondary endpoints: PSD P-SIM responses (itch, pain, scaling) at Week 16, and safety endpoints (TEAEs, serious TEAEs, TEAEs leading to discontinuation) through Week 16.

Evidence search strategy: Retrieved bimekizumab Phase 3 trials (BE VIVID, BE READY, BE SURE, BE RADIANT) for efficacy and P-SIM data; safety data from pooled analyses and long-term studies; Japanese patient data as proxy for Asian ethnicity.

Key sources: BE VIVID/BE SURE/BE RADIANT trials show PASI90 ~85-90%, PASI100 ~60-65%, IGA 0/1 ~85% at Week 16. P-SIM responses for itch/pain/scaling show strong correlation with skin clearance. Safety: TEAEs ~60-70%, serious TEAEs ~2-4%, discontinuation ~2-5% through Week 16.

Population match: Chinese population expected similar to Japanese and global Phase 3 given comparable IL-17 pathway biology. No direct Chinese Phase 3 data available pre-cutoff. Evidence role: indirect_direction for Chinese-specific estimates; direct_numeric for bimekizumab mechanism efficacy.

Endpoint-specific analysis: secondary-6 (P-SIM scaling): Expected response rate ~65-75% at Week 16 based on correlation with PASI90 achievement. secondary-7 (TEAEs): Expected ~65-75% incidence. secondary-8 (serious TEAEs): Expected ~2-4%. secondary-9 (TEAEs leading to discontinuation): Expected ~2-5%.

Safety considerations: Bimekizumab dual IL-17A/F inhibition shows acceptable safety; candidiasis and IBD are known risks but discontinuation rates remain low. No new safety signals expected in Chinese population.
Key uncertainties: Lack of direct Chinese Phase 3 data; P-SIM scaling response exact rate not directly reported but inferred from related symptoms; safety rates extrapolated from global pooled data.
Coverage gaps: No direct NCT06011733 results (trial ongoing at cutoff); no Chinese-specific subgroup analysis published; P-SIM scaling endpoint exact definition variability unknown.

matches.human_readable_report: NCT06011733 是 bimekizumab 治疗中国中重度斑块型银屑病的 III 期试验，Gold 组序为 OG000=ITP Placebo、OG001=ITP BKZ，主要终点是 Week 16 的 PASI90（OG001 94.0% 对 OG000 3.0%）与 IGA 0/1（92.0% 对 3.0%）。kimi 模型对全部 10 个合同终点都给出了结构化预测：主终点 PASI90 预测 0.86（CI 0.82-0.90）、安慰剂 0.05，IGA 0/1 预测 0.82/0.04；Week 4 PASI75 预测 0.72/0.08，与 Gold 74.0/3.0 仅差 2.0 个百分点，是全部终点中最准的一条。PASI100 预测 0.58/0.02 对 65.0/0，方向与梯度正确。但 P-SIM 症状族系统性低估：瘙痒 0.68 对 84.1 低 16.1 个百分点、疼痛 0.62 对 86.1 低 24.1 个百分点、鳞屑 0.70 对 91.6 低 21.6 个百分点，且鳞屑只给单臂。安全终点方面，TEAE 预测 0.70 对 OG001 62.0 高估 8.0 个百分点、严重 TEAE 0.03 对 1.0/9.1、停药 0.035 对 1.0/3.0，均缺安慰剂行，未能捕捉 OG000 严重 TEAE 9.1% 高于药臂 1.0% 的反常格局。过程层面，analysis_trace 十二步链条完整，机制为 IL-17A/F 双抑制并引用 BE SURE/BE READY 类全球 III 期证据，明确承认无中国 P-SIM 数据；但主终点窄 CI 未覆盖 94.0、confidence 0.82 偏高，外推折损系数没有可核查出处。检索共 9 条查询、16 次调用返回 111 条、86 个 URL 被服务，12 次调用被 registry 403 或 PubMed 解析失败阻断，max_doc 2026-01-23 未越过 cutoff 2026-01-31；不足是无中国人群量化锚点、安全谱证据未被用于校准 62.0/51.5 的真实组间格局。综合判断：方向与结构是强项，绝对量级与安慰剂背景是主要短板。
matches.judge_comments: 对 NCT06011733 的复核意见：模型把 10 个终点全部结构化输出这一点优于同批多数样本，且疗效方向零反向，PASI75 Week 4 的 0.72 对 74.0 说明其对皮肤清除类终点的外推基本可靠。真正的风险集中在两处：一是 P-SIM 症状族（瘙痒 84.1、疼痛 86.1、鳞屑 91.6）被统一压到 0.62-0.70，暴露出以皮肤清除率近似症状应答的换算偏差；二是安全终点只建药臂，OG000 的 9.1% 严重 TEAE 反常完全在视野之外，若用于 Go/No-Go 会误判安全边界。建议未来对该类人群桥接试验要求：症状终点必须给双臂，安全终点必须引用同适应症安慰剂谱。审计阻断率 12/16 偏高但 served 86 条尚可，max_doc 2026-01-23 合规。

gold_value.measure: Percentage of Participants With Psoriasis Area Severity Index 90 (PASI90) Response at Week 16
gold_value.analysis_population:
The Randomized Set (RS) included all randomized study participants.
Study participants with discontinuation of IMP prior to Week 16 or who had missing data at Week 16 were counted as non-responders (Non-responder imputation [NRI]).

endpoint_reviews.value_assessment: 模型 primary-0 给 Bimekizumab 0.86（CI 0.82-0.90）、Placebo 0.05，换算 86% 对 5%；Gold OG001 为 94.0%、OG000 为 3.0%。药臂低估 8.0 个百分点，安慰剂高估 2.0 个百分点，方向量级基本落在同一档位。
endpoint_reviews.direction_assessment: 模型方向 higher_is_better 与 Gold 一致：Bimekizumab 0.86 远高于 Placebo 0.05，对应 OG001 94.0 高于 OG000 3.0，治疗效应方向判断正确。
endpoint_reviews.group_timepoint_assessment: 模型两组标签 Bimekizumab/Placebo 可映射到 OG001/OG000，但未声明 OG000 是 ITP Placebo 在前的时间点排列；Week 16 与 Gold 的 Week 16 一致，组别与时间点基本对齐。
endpoint_reviews.reason:
证据：primary-0 是 Week 16 PASI90 应答率，模型 effect_point=0.86、CI 0.82-0.90、两组 0.86/0.05；Gold 为 OG001 94.0%、OG000 3.0%（percentage of participants）。
优点与不足：优点是双臂都给出预测且方向正确、CI 完整；不足是以小数比例表示而 Gold 用百分比，且 0.86 较 94.0 低 8.0 个百分点、安慰剂 0.05 较 3.0 高 2.0 个百分点，CI 0.82-0.90 未覆盖 94.0。
评分档位依据：方向正确且组别齐全记基准 100，扣 18（药臂低估 8.0 个百分点且 CI 未覆盖）、扣 10（安慰剂偏差与单位换算瑕疵），100 - 18 - 10 = 72。
